purpose: Teach: 高音/逸話/吸引/教区/脱皮/表層/平原/氷河

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員のプレゼンで高音すぎる声は控えさせろ
lines.en: I won't have our staff presenting with voices that are too high-pitched. Keep that in check.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each clause lands firmly. No warmth, no negotiation. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業逸話を社員教育に活かします
lines.en: Understood. I'll incorporate the company's founding story into staff training.
lines.style: Steady, professional confirmation. Slight pause after 'Understood'—showing he's already mentally processing the instruction into action. Clear and assured without being overeager.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、空気吸引設備の点検を徹底しろ
lines.en: And I want the air filtration equipment inspected thoroughly. No gaps.
lines.style: Direct, measured. The word 'thoroughly' gets a small emphasis. Matter-of-fact, like checking off a basic operational standard, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。販売教区、つまり商圏戦略を見直します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review our sales territories—our market strategy needs a full overhaul.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment with a slight self-correction mid-sentence. Shows he's thinking in real time, clarifying his own approach. Grounded and methodical.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、組織の脱皮を促進しろ
lines.en: Your organization needs to shed its old skin. Make that happen.
lines.style: Firm and deliberate. 'Shed' lands with quiet weight. No flourish—just the expectation that this will be done. The voice of someone used to setting standards.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。表層的な改革ではなく根本改革をします
lines.en: Understood. We won't settle for surface-level changes. This will be a fundamental restructuring.
lines.style: Respectful but assured. A small emphasis on 'fundamental'—showing he understands the depth of what's being asked and is ready for it. No hesitation in his commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 北米平原市場への進出を検討しろ
lines.en: We're exploring expansion into the North American market.
lines.style: Deliberate, forward-focused. 'Exploring' delivered with quiet confidence. The tone of a leader laying out a strategic direction, not asking for debate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。氷河地帯の観光ビジネスも調査します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also investigate the glacier zone tourism business for potential opportunities.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient. Shows he's already thinking three steps ahead, adding value beyond what was asked. Ends with quiet momentum—ready to move forward and report back.
